22.reason: Supported conditionally when documentation shows substantially increased work beyond typical internal anal sphincter chemodenervation; payer review expected.

50.reason: CMS bilateral indicator is 0; CPT 46505 is treated as non-bilateral/inherent midline sphincter work, so modifier 50 is intentionally excluded.

59.reason: Supported only for NCCI modifier-indicator-1 edit pairs when documentation supports a distinct procedural service; forbidden for modifier-indicator-0 pairs.

76.reason: Supported for repeat CPT 46505 by the same physician or qualified professional when separately medically necessary.

77.reason: Supported for repeat CPT 46505 by a different physician or qualified professional when separately medically necessary.

78.reason: Supported for unplanned return to the OR/procedure room for a related procedure during a postoperative global period.

79.reason: Supported for unrelated CPT 46505 during another procedure's postoperative global period.

XE.reason: Supported for modifier-indicator-1 NCCI pairs when a separate encounter is documented.

XS.reason: Supported for modifier-indicator-1 NCCI pairs when a separate anatomic site/structure is documented; not a bilateral marker for 46505.

XP.reason: Supported for modifier-indicator-1 NCCI pairs when a separate practitioner performs the distinct service.

XU.reason: Supported for modifier-indicator-1 NCCI pairs when a distinct, non-overlapping service is documented.
